CustomField.description: Master switch for the deterministic claim-level fabrication check (no model call). Default true: every concrete verifiable specific in the draft (API names like SSIC_Policy__c, CamelCase identifiers, code/merge syntax, version numbers) must appear in a cited source or the customer's own case text, else the draft is blocked (NO_DRAFT_UNGROUNDED). Catches invented specifics that reuse source vocabulary and so pass the aggregate-overlap grounding check.
CustomField.label: Draft Claim Check Enabled
